summary: CorMedix Inc. filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) reporting an executive leadership change. The Board appointed Elizabeth Hurlburt, previously COO, to the new role of Chief Operating and Commercial Officer, with oversight of commercial, medical affairs, regulatory and clinical functions, reporting to CEO Joseph Todisco. Michael Seckler has left the company. The filing includes no financial terms, premiums, or advisors. As a forced/abrupt departure triggering a structural management change, this is classified as a Management Changes special situation. Further announcements on transition or strategic impact may follow.
